en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural church with a bell tower and attached buildings in an alpine meadow. Behind it are forested hills or low mountains. The church has a simple plastered exterior, a steep shingled roof and a square bell tower topped with a pointed spire and cross. Next to it is a two‑storey house or guesthouse with shutters and dormer windows; a mid‑20th‑century car is parked in front. A large tree stands in the foreground and wild grass covers the field. The scene is quiet and pastoral, with no visible people. A signboard appears above the entrance of the right‑hand building, but the text is too small to read.
